feature_name: FREE SPINS FEATURE and SUPER SAW FREE SPINS
written_rules: During the FREE SPINS FEATURE and the SUPER SAW FREE SPINS, for each HARD HAT symbol that lands on an active position with BRICK FRAME, an existing frame on a different active position is upgraded, a new frame is added to a different active position, or a prize is awarded, based on the rules below:
- If there exists an active position with STICK FRAME, then a randomly chosen STICK FRAME is upgraded to BRICK FRAME.
- Otherwise, if there exists an active position with STRAW FRAME, then a randomly chosen STRAW FRAME is upgraded to STICK FRAME.
- Otherwise, if there exists a frameless active position, then STRAW FRAME is added to a randomly chosen frameless position.
